privileged_info_summary: The classroom_material_overhaul task uses real, non-synthetic data: the official Blender 4.2.4 demo file 'classroom.blend' from the Blender repository (released June 13, 2019, 31MB). The task breaks 4 materials (floor, wall, desk, glass) by resetting them to flat grey, then requires the agent to restore realistic material properties. Material color ranges specified are appropriate for Blender normalized RGB values: floor brown [R:0.15-0.6, G:0.08-0.35, B:0.02-0.2], walls light/white [R:0.7-1.0, G:0.7-1.0, B:0.7-1.0], desk brown [R:0.2-0.6, G:0.1-0.4, B:0.02-0.2], and glass transmission threshold of 0.5. Floor roughness range [0.3-0.7] is standard for wooden flooring. The environment downloads demo files from https://download.blender.org/demo/test/ during setup.
